## Setup
```{r load-packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load libraries
library(rprojroot)
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(SeuratObject)
library(scCustomize)
library(presto)
library(AUCell)
library(sccomp)

# Define directories
root_dir <- find_root(has_dir(".git"))
data_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "data", "v2")
analysis_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "murine-cart-tumor")
results_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "results")
plot_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "plots")

# Source custom theme
source(file.path(root_dir, "figures", "theme.R"))

# Source function
source(file.path(analysis_dir, "util", "run_doubletfinder.R"))
source(file.path(analysis_dir, "util", "run_soupx.R"))

# set random seed
set.seed(1234)
```
